output.summary: A perennial herb or low shrub native to Arizona, California, Nevada and Oregon in the western United States, and Baja California in northwestern Mexico. Hairy branching stems carry mostly unlobed oval or lance-shaped leaves, followed from February to June by clusters of purple-blue flowers and green berries. All parts are toxic, especially unripe fruit.
output.edibilityNote: All parts are toxic, especially unripe fruit; poisoning may affect the heart, nervous system and digestion.
